readerQuestion: What should I review before submitting my own template and cover for public display?

applicableClaims.name: SpicyBox Terms of Use, sections 2, 4, 5 and 7.2
applicableClaims.note: Read the current PDF. It requires eligible adults to upload only themselves, warns of generated distortions, and distinguishes private templates from reviewed public templates and their covers. No generation or quality result is claimed.
